1170-1329-2478-8296.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Mishra's Bauble from your graveyard.
Cast Mishra's Bauble by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Mishra's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2131-2921-4574-6900--44.description:
Sacrifice the templated artifact.
Resolve the ability of your sacrifice outlet.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Arcbound Reclaimer, putting the artifact on top of your library.
Your leaves-the-graveyard effect triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast the templated artifact for 0 life through Gwenom.
Repeat.
2131-2921-4574-6900--44.notes:
This combo will only result in creature ETB/LTB/etc. if the chosen card from the template is an artifact creature, in which case creature-specific sacrifice outlets may also be used.
For artifacts from the template that can sacrifice themselves, the free sacrifice outlet is unnecessary.

2023-3499-4770-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Aragorn triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Soldier creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Human Soldier token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2232-7827-7832-7836.easyPrerequisites: One of the Dwarves with mana value 1 must be on your hand, with the other on the battlefield.
2232-7827-7832-7836.description:
Cast the Dwarf with mana value 1 that's in your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the Dwarf enters, Cloudstone Curio and Thorin trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the other Dwarf with mana value 1 from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thorin trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R/W}.
Repeat.

2033-4359-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
2033-4359-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
2033-4359-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

2743-6231-7694.notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
2743-6231-7694.description:
Activate Thunderclap Drake by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing it.
Cast Multiversal Incursion by paying its mana cost
Thunderclap Drake triggers, copying Multiversal Incursion at least twice
Resolve all Multiversal Incursion spells, creating at least three copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers, causing you to win the game.

5003-5256-7283-7649.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Thorin.
When Thorin dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Thorin from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Thorin enters, it triggers, attaching Nim Deathmantle to Raphael, and then having Raphael deal 6 damage to itself.
Raphael triggers, adding six {R}.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.
5003-5256-7283-7649.notes: Once you have infinite mana, the damage dealt to Raphael can instead be dealt to any creature(s).

1017-2713-4866-7426.easyPrerequisites: There's a removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
1017-2713-4866-7426.description:
Activate Sage of Fables by paying {1} due to Zirda and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, causing you to draw a card.
Wizard Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

206-3259-4689.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
206-3259-4689.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Otharri as attackers.
Otharri triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

5507-5929-6871-6879.description:
Cast Inquisitive Puppet by paying {1}.
When Inquisitive Puppet enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, it and Haru trigger.
Resolve the Inquisitve Puppet trigger, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve the Haru trigger, earthbending Inquisitive Puppet as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Inquisitive Puppet by exiling it.
Toph triggers, returning Inquisitve Puppet from exile to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat steps 2 through 4 once.
Resolve the Inquisitive Puppet ability from step 5, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat from step 5.

147-2438-6817.description:
Cast Presumed Dead by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Presumed Dead, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Presumed Dead.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Carrion Feeder abilities from step 5.

1978-4324-5527.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Clues.
1978-4324-5527.description:
Animate Five Hundred Year Diary using Workshop Elders.
Activate Five Hundred Year Diary by tapping it, adding {U} for each Clue you control
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Five Hundred Year Diary.
Repeat from step 2.

2232-3821-3967-6843.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
2232-3821-3967-6843.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Anti-Venom by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
When Anti-Venom enters, its first ability and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Anti-Venom trigger, returning Peregrine Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Anti-Venom from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Peregrine Drake.
Repeat.

2438-3090-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2390-2919-6799.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give All Will Be One lifelink.
You have a way to gain life.
2390-2919-6799.description:
Cast Relive the Past by paying {5}{G}{W}, returning All Will Be One from your graveyard to the battlefield as a creature.
Give All Will Be One lifelink.
Gain life in any way.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and causing you to gain at least 1 life.
Repeat from step 4.

2060-2946-6701-6798.easyPrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2060-2946-6701-6798.description:
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
2060-2946-6701-6798.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana needed to activate the creature's ability from your graveyard.

3951-4192-5703-6797.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
3951-4192-5703-6797.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

5043-5078-5231-6766.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Alela triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Faerie, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Repeat.

1621-4753.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Clever Impersonator.
1621-4753.description:
Cast Clever Impersonator by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel
When Clever Impersonator enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Clever Impersonator. Choose to have Clever Impersonator enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
Repeat from step 2.

301-4050-5643.notablePrerequisites:
Putrid Goblin does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
You have had at least one Zombie enter the battlefield under your control this turn.
301-4050-5643.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Putrid Goblin, adding one mana of any color.
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your cotnrol this turn.
Repeat.

3693-4613-5338.easyPrerequisites:
Francisco has a +1/+1 counter on it.
The top card of your library isn't a land card.
Walking Ballista is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
3693-4613-5338.description:
Activate Francisco by using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Francisco triggers, revealing the top card of your library, then putting it back on top and putting a +1/+1 counter on Francisco.
Repeat.

Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crookshank Kobolds enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio and Seed the Land trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing to return nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a 1/1 Snake creature token.
When the Snake enters the battlefield, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Crookshank Kobolds from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1692-1803-2034-3951.notablePrerequisites:
Helm of the Host attached to Éomer.
Kari Zev does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
1692-1803-2034-3951.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Éomer with haste.
Declare Kari Zev as an attacker.
Kari Zev triggers, creating a legendary 2/1 Ragavan creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ragavan, adding {C}{C}.
When Ragavan dies, each Éomer that hasn't triggered this turn triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get at least one additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1530-2928-2963-3544.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is five or less.
1530-2928-2963-3544.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and take an extra turh after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Teleportation Circle triggers, blinking Auramancer.
When Auramancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Second Chance from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Second Chance by paying {2}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

851-1245.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures
851-1245.description:
Activate Tooth and Claw by sacrificing two creatures, creating two 3/1 Carnivore creature tokens.
Repeat.

2781-4681-5256.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
Felidar Guardian's ability triggers, targeting Karmic Guide.
In response, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Felidar Guardian, causing target player to mill a card.
Resolve Feldiar Guardian's trigger, blinking Karmic Guide.
Karmic Guide triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

624-3305-3734-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Phantasmal Image, adding one mana of any color.
Phantasmal Image dies, triggering its second ability and Body Launderer's first ability.
Resolve the Phantasmal Image trigger, returning Phyrexian Metamorph from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Body Launderer.
Resolve the Body Launderer trigger, causing it to connive.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Phyrexian Metamorph, adding one mana of any color.
Phyrexian Metamorph dies, triggering its second ability and Body Launderer's first ability.
Resolve the Phyrexian Metamorph trigger, returning Phantasmal Image from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Body Launderer.
Resolve the Body Launderer trigger, causing it to connive.
Repeat.

1518-1987-2556-5116.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
1518-1987-2556-5116.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Gilded Lotus by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Gilded Lotus and Mnemonic Wall, blinking them.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
Repeat.

1657-1988-3020-4050.notablePrerequisites: Blade of the Bloodchief is attached to Murderous Redcap.
1657-1988-3020-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Puppeteer Clique, adding one mana of any color.
Puppeteer Clique dies, triggering its persist ability and Blade of the Bloodchief.
Resolve the Puppeteer Clique trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Puppeteer Clique enters the battlefield, putting target creature from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control until end of turn.
Resolve the Blade of the Bloodchief trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Murderous Redcap.
Equip Blade of the Bloodchief to Puppeteer Clique by paying {1}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Murderous Redcap, adding one mana of any color.
Murderous Redcap dies, triggering its persist ability and Blade of the Bloodchief.
Resolve Murderous Redcap's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Murderous Redcap enters the battlefield, dealing damage equal to its power to any target.
Resolve the Blade of the Bloodchief trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Puppeteer Clique.
Equip Blade of the Bloodchief to Murderous Redcap by paying {1}.
Repeat.
